The Prickly Pear

  • 2 oz. pear vodka
  • 1 oz. triple sec
  • 1 oz. pineapple juice
  • 1/2 oz. lime juice
  • top with seltzer (about 4 oz.)

Pour ingredients in order into rocks glass over ice. Give a quick stir and enjoy!

Variation: champagne/sparkling wine instead of seltzer, a tad bit sweeter and of course stronger
